data.name: avail_list.ToolTip
data.value: This list contains all installed plugin files (windows) of your MediaPortal installation. Install new plugins and they will automatically appear in this list and you will be able to add them to main or submenus of the backdrops skin.

data.name: comboBox17.ToolTip
data.value: With the Backdrop Type field, you can specify if the backdrops should rotate between images or if it shhould only be a single image or if you want to use the fanart plugin (recommended) to display multiple images. Choose "Fanart Plugin" to use the images you put in the /thumbs/Skin Fanart/xxx directory. Use "Muiltiple Images" to use MP standard way of displaying multiple cycling images (memory intensive option) or "Single Image" if you want to specify one specific image that should allways be shown for this menu.

data.name: comboBox16.ToolTip
data.value: The Backdrop Id/Path/Name field is used to specify the name of a single backdrop image or the path to a directory containing multiple backdrops or the fanart id. The image(s) will be displayed when the menu item has focus. A few example paths that are available in the standard installation: emulator, games, lastfm, lyrics, movies, music, pictures, Play, pluginsbg, programsbg, radio, settings, shutdownbg, suduko, tetris, tv, tvguide, tvseries, weatherbg, worldmap. If you do not like the default black and white menu images, just change the image name to the respective color image. Example, change menu_pictures.png to menu_pictures_color.png.

data.name: new_name.ToolTip
data.value: The Text field is free text that you can customize/localize at free will. This is the text that will be on the submenu menu in the skin. Depending on the actual characters you use in the text field, you should be able to enter text up to 12 or 16 characters long. For example, a capital W will take up more space than a small i. That is why it is difficult to limit the editor to a specific number of characters. If your text is too long, it will just overlap.

data.name: button17.ToolTip
data.value: Click this button to generate new basichome pages that will be used in MediaPortal. Clicking this button does not save the configuration you have made in this tool. You will be asked to save your settings when you press the close [X] button at top right of this dialog.
